$comment: Schema for protocol/non_register_entities.canonical.json — calculated ESPHome / ESP32-browser-UI / local-config entities that are NOT BMS registers (spec section 5.4).

category.description: mock_backend_only: published only by demo/mock-server.js (a browser-registered route with no production batterylifepo4.yaml/components publisher); listed so the UI never treats it as a BMS register, without implying firmware support.

derived_from_register_key.description: Stage 5: when this computed entity is a direct, same-read derivation of one real register field (e.g. total_voltage from total_voltage_raw), names that field's key so generate.js's buildFieldMeta() can inherit its poll_group/freshness_budget_s instead of leaving this entity permanently un-stale-able. Omit/null when there is no single real register this value traces to (e.g. power = V x I, computed from two different registers).
